title: Erika Kirk posts heartbreaking wedding photo to honor husband Charlie on anniversary of his murder
text:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

Erika Kirk paid tribute to her slain husband, Charlie Kirk, Thursday by posting a wedding photo on social media with a poignant message on the one-year anniversary of his murder.

The black-and-white photo showed Erika, in her wedding dress, and Charlie, in his suit, holding hands during their nuptials.

“…until Heaven,” read the message in the center of the photo, which Erika shared on X.

Erika, a former Arizona beauty queen and college basketball player, married Charlie in May 2021.

Charlie, 31, was shot and killed by a sniper at Utah Valley University a year ago Thursday, during one of his signature “Prove me wrong” events at the Orem campus.

Events honoring the influential Turning Point USA founder are being held across the country to mark the one-year anniversary of his death, including at the site of Charlie’s assassination.

Charlie was also honored in an inspiring tribute video played on Night Two of the Republican midterm convention in Dallas.

Erika, 37, is not planning to mark the anniversary publicly.

“Erika will mark the anniversary of Charlie’s death privately with her and Charlie’s two young children, their family, and close friends,” a family spokesperson said.

“She is so grateful for the continued outpouring of prayers, love, and support as she and her family remember and honor Charlie as the beloved husband and father he was.”

Erika, who was elected CEO of Turning Point USA shortly after her husband’s murder, made a surprise appearance at the GOP midterm convention Wednesday night.

She didn’t speak at the convention, but was seated in the VIP section as President Trump delivered his keynote address.

“I just want to say we love you, Charlie,” Trump said in his remarks.

“She’s put up with something. Boy, oh, boy. What she’s had to go through,” he said of Erika. “It was a beautiful family.

“It’s just terrible.”

Erika is not expected to attend the convention Thursday night.
